$comment: FROZEN golden v1.0 (50 tickets). Exemplars TICKET-0001..0005 human-labeled (AB). TICKET-0006..0050 AI-drafted (AI-1) and AI-2 second-labeled per guidelines.md section 5 (2 unconfident + 9-record 20% sample, zero label changes on re-derivation). Labels change only via a new version. Human sign-off recommended before external quoting of eval numbers.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.account: login, password, profile, subscription status, data requests

refund.instructions: Does the customer ask for money back?

records.text: Hi, I was billed twice for my annual CloudSync Pro renewal — [ORDER] shows two charges of $249, one on the 3rd and one on the 4th. I already checked with my bank. Please refund the duplicate charge today.

meta.notes: Money-primary complaint → billing; explicit time pressure ('today') + money blocked → 1; direct money-back ask → refund true.

records.text: The desktop app crashes every time I try to export a board larger than 50 cards. There's a workaround (exporting in chunks) so it's not blocking me, but it should be fixed at some point.

meta.notes: Something broken → technical; explicit workaround + no time claim → 0 despite the crash (impact-based, not tone-based).

records.text: We're evaluating CloudSync Pro for a team of 12. Is there a discount at that seat count, and does the Business plan include the audit log add-on or is that priced separately?

meta.notes: Pre-purchase pricing question → sales; pure question → 0.

records.text: My account got locked this morning after the 2FA reset and I cannot access CloudSync Pro at all — I have client deliverables due tomorrow and the paid product is completely unusable. Nothing I try unlocks it.

meta.notes: H2 variant: account-access blocking is the primary state (not the invoice context) → account; 'cannot access paid product at all' asserted → 2.

records.text: Your November invoice double-charged the seat count after we removed two users. No need to send anything back to my card — please just issue a credit note for the difference and apply it to the next invoice.

meta.notes: H4: money-adjacent wording, but a credit note is store credit, NOT money back → refund false. Money complaint → billing; no time claim → 0.

records.text: Your March invoice billed the old twelve-seat rate after we downgraded to eight seats in February. Please refund the difference for [ORDER] — the new rate is confirmed in the admin console.

meta.notes: Money-primary → billing; direct refund ask → true; no time claim → 0.

records.text: Our desktop-to-cloud sync started failing yesterday morning — files upload halfway and then stop. Two team members are blocked from pushing changes, and support chat has been queuing for an hour.

meta.notes: Sync failure → technical; 'since yesterday' + members blocked → 1.

records.text: Somos una organización sin fines de lucro con veinticinco personas. ¿Ofrecen descuento para ONG en el plan Business y se puede probar el complemento de auditoría antes de comprar?

meta.notes: Pre-purchase discount/trial question → sales; pure question → 0.

records.text: A sign-in alert at 3am showed an attempt from another country on my workspace account, and after resetting my password the unknown session keeps reappearing in active devices. Please secure the account now — and refund this month, since the workspace has been unusable all morning while I locked everything down.

meta.notes: Security incident on account state → account (tie-break: the refund ask does not move dept); security incident → 2; money-back ask → refund true.

records.text: A cancelled add-on still appears on the latest invoice as a separate line. Please reverse that charge for [ORDER]; our bookkeeping needs it cleared before Friday's close.

meta.notes: Wrong charge → billing; 'reverse the charge' = money back → true; deadline Friday → 1.

records.text: La app móvil olvida mis filtros guardados cada vez que la cierro. No es urgente, pero parece un fallo: los ajustes deberían conservarse entre sesiones.

meta.notes: Bug report → technical; explicitly not urgent, no impact asserted → 0.

records.text: We're ready to move thirty seats from Starter to Business this week. Send the upgrade quote and proration details so we can approve before Friday's budget meeting.

meta.notes: Upgrade → sales; deadline Friday → 1.

records.text: My profile email was updated to [EMAIL] but the verification message never arrives and the account page still shows the old address. We onboard new hires next week and need this working before then.

meta.notes: Profile/verification state → account; deadline next week → 1.

records.text: After the merger migration our company card was charged for a different tenant entirely, and finance has frozen the card pending the correction. We need the wrong charges refunded today — three departments' payments are blocked until then.

meta.notes: Wrong-charges complaint → billing; money actively blocked → 2; refund ask → true.

records.text: Wir möchten die Workspace-Verwaltung an einen zweiten Admin übergeben, da ich im Herbst aussteige. Unterstützt CloudSync Pro die Übertragung der Eigentümerrolle direkt in der Konsole?

meta.notes: H9: German ticket with English product name (CloudSync Pro) — language-routing subtlety; ownership/role question → account; question → 0.

records.text: Production webhook deliveries stopped at 8am — the endpoint returns 200 but zero events arrive, so customer order confirmations are silently failing right now. The changelog still documents the old signature scheme.

meta.notes: Integration failure → technical; live production impact with customer-facing failures → 2.

records.text: Every batch export through the API has failed since yesterday's release and today's client uploads are impossible — the core export function is completely unusable for our team right now.

meta.notes: API failure → technical; 'completely unusable' asserted → 2 (impact-based, not duration).

records.text: 我们已把所有资料迁移到新工作区，请删除旧工作区的数据，并在清理完成后发送确认。谢谢。

meta.notes: Data deletion request → account; no time pressure → 0.

records.text: Our card was billed at the full annual rate instead of the June promotion rate because the checkout retry bug applied the price change twice. Please refund the overcharge for [ORDER], correct the rate going forward, and stop tomorrow's autopay draft until it is fixed.

meta.notes: H1: bug described in detail pulls toward technical, but the complaint is money-primary → billing (tie-break recorded); tomorrow's draft at risk → 1; overcharge refund ask → true.

records.text: I disputed the duplicate charge with my bank this morning after a week of waiting for a response from billing. The charge for [ORDER] is now being reversed through the chargeback process on my statement.

meta.notes: H3: no word 'refund', but a chargeback is a money-back demand → refund true; 'after a week of waiting' → 1.

records.text: Since this morning every shared link returns access denied for external partners and nothing can be sent to clients — deliverables due tomorrow cannot go out at all. Please also refund this month's fee; the product is completely unusable for us today.

meta.notes: Broken sharing feature is the primary complaint → technical (tie-break: refund ask doesn't move dept); total inability + deadline → 2; money-back ask → true.

records.text: We first asked about an enterprise tier with on-prem sync two years ago. Is that still on the roadmap? We're comfortable on Standard — just checking in.

meta.notes: H7: two-year duration does NOT raise urgency — explicitly comfortable → 0; roadmap/pre-purchase → sales.

records.text: Our SSO sign-in broke after the identity-provider certificate rotation this morning — regular users get errors and cannot open any workspace document. Twenty people are completely locked out while admins still get in.

meta.notes: Login/SSO state → account (tie-break: config-flavored but the blocking state is access); 'cannot open any document' for 20 users → 2.

records.text: If we cancel our annual plan mid-term next year, how are refunds for unused months handled? No issue right now — we just want the policy in writing for our procurement file.

meta.notes: H8: the word 'refund' appears but it is a policy QUESTION, not a money-back request → false; billing-policy question → billing; hypothetical → 0.

records.text: The beta dark-mode toggle sometimes resets to light mode after a restart. Cosmetic only, no workflow impact, but noting it for the fix list.

meta.notes: Cosmetic bug → technical; explicitly no impact → 0.

records.text: A sign-in alert at 3am showed an attempt from another country, and after resetting my password the unknown session reappears in the active devices list. Treat this as a live security incident and secure the account now.

meta.notes: Account security → account; security incident asserted → 2.

records.text: The annual renewal went out at the wrong tier after our mid-cycle seat change. Refund the overage on [ORDER] and reissue the invoice at the correct tier — our CFO wants this closed this week.

meta.notes: Wrong-tier renewal → billing; refund ask → true; 'this week' → 1.

records.text: We're comparing CloudSync Pro with two competitors for a two-hundred-seat rollout next quarter. Can your team walk us through migration tooling and volume pricing before our evaluation call on Thursday?

meta.notes: Pre-purchase evaluation → sales; deadline Thursday → 1.

records.text: Hello team, je souhaite renommer l'espace de travail avec le nom de notre nouvelle filiale et changer le contact de facturation. Quelles sont les étapes à suivre ?

meta.notes: H9: French ticket starting with an English greeting ('Hello team') — subtle for language routing; workspace settings → account; how-to → 0.

records.text: The Android client drains battery and overheats since yesterday's 4.2 update, and three colleagues with the same phone report identical behavior. Mobile sync is how we work all day.

meta.notes: Client bug → technical; 'since yesterday' + daily-workflow reliance, degraded not blocked → 1.

records.text: Our subscription card was charged five times in error tonight and the bank has now declined the card, including for the customer payments we run through it. Refund all duplicate charges immediately — this is actively blocking revenue.

meta.notes: Duplicate charges → billing; money actively blocked → 2; refund ask → true.

records.text: Die Tastenkombination zum Einklappen von Unterhaltungen funktioniert auf Windows 11 nicht, obwohl sie in der Doku steht. Kleinigkeit, aber die Tabelle sollte stimmen.

meta.notes: Minor bug → technical; explicitly minor → 0.

records.text: Does the per-seat price drop at one hundred seats, and is there an additional annual prepay discount beyond the listed rates?

meta.notes: Pre-purchase pricing → sales; question → 0.

records.text: After the reorganization, admin permissions must move from [PERSON], who left the company, to our two new team leads. Access requests are piling up while we wait.

meta.notes: Permissions state → account; 'piling up' = degraded workflow → 1.

records.text: I cancelled my personal plan last month and the confirmation is in my account history, but this cycle was still charged. Please refund the monthly fee.

meta.notes: Wrong charge after cancellation → billing; refund ask → true; no time claim → 0.

records.text: The desktop app hangs for thirty to sixty seconds when opening any workspace over ten gigabytes since last week's update. Workable, but it makes our video team's daily reviews painful.

meta.notes: Performance bug → technical; 'workable' + degraded daily workflow → 1 (not 2: not total inability).

records.text: Can two-factor authentication be enforced as a default policy for every member of our workspace instead of per-user opt-in?

meta.notes: Workspace security policy/settings → account; question → 0.

records.text: After the surprise price increase I'm cancelling both seats at the next renewal, which hits next week. We signed at the old rate and were overcharged since the change, so confirm the cancellation now.

meta.notes: H10: cancellation because of overcharge → billing (tie-break recorded); NO money-back ask → refund false (cancellation ≠ refund); 'next week' → 1.

records.text: Nightly sync has failed three nights in a row and every manual attempt this morning returns a server error. We cannot ship today's release without the synced artifacts — production is blocked.

meta.notes: Sync failure → technical; 'cannot ship today' = total inability + deadline → 2 (duration alone never promotes, the asserted impact does).

records.text: We deploy CloudSync Pro for our consulting clients and love it — do you run a partner or reseller program for agencies like us?

meta.notes: Partner program inquiry → sales; question → 0.

records.text: After a login alert from another country I reset my password, but the unknown session keeps reappearing and my recovery codes are spent. I still have one trusted laptop — secure the account before every other device is compromised.

meta.notes: Account security → account; live security incident → 2.

records.text: The CSV export from the billing portal wraps every field in quotes since Monday's release, so imports into our ledger tool now reject the whole file. The previous format worked — please fix the export or restore the old format.

meta.notes: Broken export feature → technical despite billing-portal context (tie-break: the complaint is a malfunction, not money); imports failing = degraded workflow → 1.

records.text: ASAP!! How do I switch my notifications to the daily digest? I keep getting pinged every few minutes and it's driving me nuts. This is really urgent!!

meta.notes: H6: urgent tone on a how-to question — tone ≠ urgency → 0; how-to fell out of the department tree → confident:false, QC-resolved to technical (settings how-to).

records.text: The invoice regenerated after our plan change and double-billed the September seats. Please refund the extra charge on [ORDER] — bookkeeping closes Monday.

meta.notes: Double-bill → billing; refund ask → true; deadline Monday → 1.

records.text: The workspace shows account suspended — payment verification required — but our card is valid and no invoice is overdue. Nobody can open a single document since 9am. Restore access immediately, and refund this billing period: we paid for a day with zero service.

meta.notes: Suspension = account state, access is the primary complaint → account (tie-break: payment-verification context pulls toward billing); total inability → 2; money-back ask → true.

records.text: There is a duplicate nine-dollar seat charge from the trial-to-paid transition on my last invoice. Everything else looks right — please refund just that charge.

meta.notes: Duplicate charge → billing; refund ask → true; no time claim → 0.

records.text: The menu-bar sync widget stopped showing status after yesterday's macOS update, and reinstalling did not help. Our ops team glances at it all day, so we are flying blind on sync health.

meta.notes: Widget broken → technical; 'since yesterday' + all-day workflow reliance, degraded → 1.

records.text: If we add five design seats mid-cycle in Q3, how is proration handled — a full month or prorated to the day? Planning the budget for the expansion.

meta.notes: Pre-purchase proration question → sales despite 'proration/budget' money words (tie-break recorded: they want to buy, not dispute a charge); hypothetical → 0.

records.text: Since yesterday's username migration the iPad app shows invalid workspace on sign-in while desktop and web work fine. I travel today and need mobile access working.

meta.notes: Device-specific error after account migration — malfunction on one client → technical (migration is context); QC second-labeled due to account-vs-technical ambiguity; travel deadline → 1.

records.text: The annual plan charge posted twice this morning — two identical lines on the bank statement. Please refund one of the two charges for [ORDER] before our finance review on Wednesday.

meta.notes: Duplicate charge → billing; refund ask → true; deadline Wednesday → 1.
